certifications.name: SOC 2
certifications.proof_quote: No SOC 2 report, attestation, or claim is published on any decktopus.com property. A third-party aggregator (Nudge Security) lists Decktopus as 'SOC 2 Compliant', but this is automated/inferred data with no vendor-domain proof, so it cannot be treated as held.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No ISO 27001 certificate or claim appears on decktopus.com, the help center, the privacy policy, or terms. Only a third-party aggregator lists it; no vendor evidence.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No HIPAA/BAA capability is claimed anywhere on the vendor's own site. The product is a general-purpose presentation tool not positioned for PHI. Third-party 'HIPAA Compliant' label is not vendor-backed.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Card data is handled by a third-party processor: 'the payment information ... that you submit when you register may be used and shared with our payment processing services provider'. No direct Decktopus PCI attestation is published.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No FedRAMP authorization exists for Decktopus (not in the FedRAMP marketplace and implausible for a consumer presentation SaaS). The third-party aggregator's 'FedRamp Compliant' label is a clear false positive and undermines the reliability of that source.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR Compliance. Any information containing personal data shall be handled in accordance with all applicable privacy laws and regulations, including without limitation the GDPR and equivalent laws and regulations.

privacy.ai_training_note: The privacy policy does not explicitly state whether user presentation content or prompts are used to train AI models. It lists generic uses such as to 'develop new products, features, and services' and to improve Services, and states 'We do not sell or rent personal information.' AI generation (DecktoGPT) is presumably powered by third-party model providers, but no AI-data-use / training-opt-out policy is published on the vendor domain. Treat training-on-customer-data as unverified.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS. Help center states data is 'encrypted during transmission to servers using TLS (Transport Layer Security)'.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256. Help center states data 'remains encrypted while stored using AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) 256-bit encryption'.

security.name: Access control / MFA
security.value: MFA required for administrative access; 'all access to data is logged and monitored in real-time'.

security.name: Data handling posture
security.value: 'We do not sell or rent personal information.' Physical, electronic, and administrative security measures stated in privacy policy; acknowledges no internet transmission is 100% secure.

security.name: Bug bounty program
security.value: None found. No HackerOne, Bugcrowd, or security.txt / vulnerability disclosure program located on the vendor domain.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Not mentioned anywhere on the vendor's own site.

security.name: Hosting infrastructure
security.value: Vendor-stated: runs on DigitalOcean server infrastructure with Auth0 for authentication, per the vendor's own help center ('Is my data safe?'). Login credentials and presentation data are held in encrypted databases, with secure connections via Let's Encrypt/TLS. Independently corroborated, though no specific data-center region is disclosed.

products.name: Decktopus AI (Pro / individual)
products.data_scope: Account contact + payment info, uploaded content, prompts, generated decks. Consumer/prosumer scope.
products.notes: Core product: prompt-to-deck, PDF import, DecktoGPT co-pilot, AI image generation.

products.name: Decktopus for Teams / Business
products.data_scope: Shared team decks, brand assets (logo, colors, fonts), templates.
products.notes: Adds shared company templates, team collaboration, Zapier integration.

products.name: Decktopus Enterprise (Auto-Branding / Light Branding)
products.data_scope: Org brand kit, branded slide library; same encryption/access controls as core platform.
products.notes: Enterprise positioning exists but no separate enterprise security attestation, DPA link, or trust portal is published.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium SaaS subscription (monthly/annual; no refunds per Terms). Free, Pro, Business, and Enterprise tiers.

flags: No dedicated trust center or security page on the vendor domain (decktopus.com/security returns 404).
Enterprise certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001) are NOT verifiable on any vendor-owned property despite enterprise marketing.

Conflicting third-party data: Nudge Security profile claims SOC 2, PCI, HIPAA, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR compliance. FedRAMP for a consumer presentation SaaS is implausible, which discredits that aggregated source; none of these are confirmed by the vendor.
No published AI/data-use policy stating whether customer presentation content or prompts are used for model training.
No DPA link, subprocessor list, or pen-test / bug-bounty disclosure found on the vendor domain.

Privacy policy last updated Feb 2024; Terms Dec 2024 (Terms contain boilerplate/templated clauses referencing GPS, emergency contacts, and 'calls' that do not fit a presentation tool, suggesting a reused template).
